newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Statistics New Zealand amends GDP components.
newsitem.headline: Statistics New Zealand amends GDP components.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand said on Wednesday said it had corrected errors in components of the June and September quarter gross domestic product data reported last week.
Errors affected only the current value expenditure series and the implicit price deflators, and not the real production or expenditure based GDP series, SNZ said.
The errors were due to the accidental omission of data from the transport component of private final consumption expenditure within the expenditure on gross domestic product series.
